en.headline: 406 own commits and 716 automated ones across 13 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: Daily-report fixes, a new sandbox and skill-management tooling, a translation extension, and pixel-art releases filled the window, alongside issue triage in OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
### Own projects

Most of the window went into the daily-report repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the AI summary layer was reworked: a duplicate empty gate was removed, blank days no longer swallow the discussion section, and truncation is now flagged in both the daily report and the AI summary. Commit attribution learned aliases so commits from non-GitHub emails are counted, and a new 30-day GitHub activity AI summary was added with a home-page card and a standalone page. The CLI gained `--force` to skip the comment-count snapshot freeze.

Two OpenCode-adjacent projects were built out. `opencode-agent-sandbox` collected knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, plus oh-my-opencode-slim findings, and corrected several outdated conclusions. `opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, shipped four releases from 0.1.0-rc.0 through v1.2.0, and moved its plans into the repository's plan directory.

### Releases and tooling

`opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, covering priced accounting with a quota-math reference, a large documentation simplification, an enforced candidate menu and per-source chains, plus fixes for atomic snapshot writes and version-badge drift. `pixel-logo-toolkit` released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and an English-first README.

`sopen-translate` started from an empty repository and grew an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, and smoke tests with JSDoc type checking. `dsh-ecosystem-report` received mobile viewport fixes, a single-button theme switcher and visual refinements. `asset-inventory` cut v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 while correcting skill invocation facts across docs and samples, and `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream issue work

Outside own repositories, activity was concentrated on issue actions in `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`, including bug reports on MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting and context-panel breakdowns, plus discussions proposing session stats and SDK exposure. One issue was opened against `microsoft/PowerToys` about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException. No pull requests or reviews were recorded.

highlights.text: Four releases from 0.1.0-rc.0 to v1.2.0 shipped the skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable.
v2.0.0 introduced priced accounting with a quota-math reference; v3.0.0 cut the skill documentation by roughly 92 percent.
v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection; v0.2.0 was the first tagged release.
Commented on the AI narrative generation failure issue.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a feature request that the Windows desktop ships the CLI with no way to run it.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation.
Started a discussion proposing session aggregate stats in the Context Usage Panel.

byRepo.text: 113 own commits plus 716 automated commits, and 6 issue actions. Work centered on the daily report: removing a duplicate empty gate in the AI layer, keeping discussion sections on blank days, flagging truncation when collection hits its cap, alias-aware commit attribution, a `--force` flag for comment-count snapshots, and a new 30-day activity AI summary with a home-page card and standalone page.

84 own commits and no automated commits. The repository was initialized and filled with knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim findings, Excalidraw sketches, and corrections to outdated conclusions about subcommands, bundled skills and Windows ports.

77 own commits, no automated commits, and 4 releases. The `skill_management` plugin was implemented with list, inspect, disable and enable, its spec was revised with a feasibility review, plans moved to the repository plan directory, line endings were normalized to LF, and releases ran from 0.1.0-rc.0 through v1.2.0 including a JSON output envelope.

56 own commits and no automated commits. Starting from an empty repository, it gained an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, page-state resets between runs, smoke tests and JSDoc type checking.

29 own commits, no automated commits, and 2 releases. v0.2.0 was the first tagged release with a bilingual CLI and English-first docs; v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection. Fixes covered Korean font selection, width reservation for right-side decorations, and pure-query commands working without Pillow.

25 own commits, no automated commits, and 4 releases. v1.4.0 added shared JSON and proxy helpers plus richer agent discovery; v2.0.0 introduced priced accounting; v3.0.0 simplified the documentation by about 92 percent; v3.0.1 enforced the candidate menu and per-source chains. Fixes included atomic snapshot writes and version-badge drift checks.

No commits, 15 issue actions and no releases. Reports covered MCP settings omitting the Console server, a stale session retention hint, a quote-card arrow that does nothing outside loaded history, unreliable line-number commenting, context-panel breakdown math, 1x browser captures and missing unlink affordances, alongside discussions on session stats and SDK exposure.

No commits, 11 issue actions and no releases. Activity focused on MiMo-V2.6-Flash image handling and stale vision reads, subagent failures with model_coming_soon, a Windows desktop CLI access request, and a worktree removal fix discussion.

11 own commits and no automated commits. Mobile fixes made tables fill the width and adapted 375 and 414 viewports; the theme switcher became a single button with a popup menu and then a compact icon segment; visual refinements added gradient top lines, KPI color bars and zebra striping, and three plugins were merged into the inventory list.

6 own commits, no automated commits, and 2 releases. v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 were cut while skill invocation facts were corrected across the skill, rule, samples, READMEs and guides, including removal of slash-command references and a Japanese localization fix.

4 own commits and no automated commits. The only changes were OpenChamber capture samples: a desktop 1440x900 image, a 1:1 panel region, a mobile 390x844 image and a session retention hint screenshot.

No commits, 1 issue action and no releases. A Shortcut Guide bug was opened reporting that Hold-Win activation throws a NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected.
1 own commit and no automated commits. The single change added DSH plugins porting OpenChamber features.

zh.headline: 30 天内 13 个仓库共 406 次本人提交、716 次自动提交
zh.teaser: 日报修复、沙箱与技能管理工具、翻译扩展和像素画工具发布构成了这段时间的主线，另有 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 的 issue 跟进。
zh.overview:
### 自有项目

这段时间大部分精力放在日报仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 上，AI 摘要层做了重构：移除重复的空内容拦截，空白天不再吞掉 discussion 等附加段，采集命中上限时会在日报和 AI 摘要中标注截断。提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交；新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结，包含首页卡片和独立页。CLI 增加 `--force`，用于跳过评论数快照冻结。

两个 OpenCode 相关项目同步推进。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 归档了 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 的实测结论，并修正了若干过期判断。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，从 0.1.0-rc.0 到 v1.2.0 共发布 4 个版本，计划文件也迁入仓库计划目录。

### 发布与工具

`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1，内容包括计价核算与 quota-math 参考、大幅精简文档、强制候选菜单与按来源的链长，以及原子快照写入和版本徽章漂移检查等修复。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0，带来自动折行、溢出保护、中英双语命令行和英文优先的 README。

`sopen-translate` 从空仓库起步，完成了 MV3 骨架、带预设与术语表流水线的 provider 协议层、分块与熔断的分页双语渲染，以及冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 做了移动端视口适配、单按钮主题切换和视觉精修。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5，同时修正了文档与示例中的技能调用说明；`myBlog` 只新增了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游 issue 跟进

自有仓库之外，活动集中在 `openchamber/openchamber` 和 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 issue 互动上，涉及 MCP 设置缺失、会话保留提示过期、引用卡片跳转无效、文件视图行号评论不稳定和上下文面板占比计算等问题，另有关于会话统计与 SDK 暴露的讨论。还向 `microsoft/PowerToys` 提交了一个 Shortcut Guide 的 NullReferenceException 问题。窗口内没有 pull request 和 review 记录。

highlights.text: 从 0.1.0-rc.0 到 v1.2.0 共 4 个版本，交付了带 list、inspect、disable、enable 的 skill_management 插件。
v2.0.0 引入计价核算与 quota-math 参考；v3.0.0 把技能文档精简约 92%。
v0.3.0 增加自动折行与溢出保护；v0.2.0 是首个正式打标签的版本。
在 AI 叙述生成失败的 issue 下参与讨论。
提交 bug：设置中的 MCP 页面漏掉了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提交功能请求：Windows 桌面版自带 CLI，却没有运行它的入口。
提交 Shortcut Guide 问题：Hold-Win 激活抛出 NullReferenceException 且无任何显示。
发起讨论，建议在上下文用量面板中加入会话汇总统计。

byRepo.text: 113 次本人提交，另有 716 次自动提交，6 次 issue 互动。工作围绕日报展开：移除 AI 层重复的空内容拦截、空白天保留 discussion 段、采集截断标注、提交归属别名、评论数快照的 `--force` 开关，以及新增带首页卡片和独立页的近 30 天活动 AI 总结。
84 次本人提交，无自动提交。仓库从初始化开始，归档了 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 实测结论和 Excalidraw 草图，并修正了子命令列表、随包技能数量和 Windows 端口等过期结论。
77 次本人提交，无自动提交，4 个版本。实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable，修订规范并做可行性评测，计划迁入仓库计划目录，换行符统一为 LF，版本从 0.1.0-rc.0 到 v1.2.0，其中包含 JSON 输出信封的改动。
56 次本人提交，无自动提交。从空仓库起步，完成 MV3 骨架、带预设、模型列表与术语表流水线的 provider 协议层、分块与熔断的分页双语渲染、运行间页面状态重置，以及冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查。
29 次本人提交，无自动提交，2 个版本。v0.2.0 是首个正式版本，带双语命令行和英文优先文档；v0.3.0 增加自动折行与溢出保护。修复包括韩语改用 Galmuri 字体、为右侧装饰让出宽度，以及缺 Pillow 时纯查询命令仍可用。
25 次本人提交，无自动提交，4 个版本。v1.4.0 加入共享的 JSON 与代理辅助函数和更完整的 agent 发现；v2.0.0 引入计价核算；v3.0.0 把文档精简约 92%；v3.0.1 强制候选菜单与按来源的链长。修复包括原子快照写入和版本徽章漂移检查。
无提交，15 次 issue 互动，无发布。报告涉及 MCP 设置漏掉 Console 服务器、会话保留提示过期、引用卡片箭头在历史外无效、行号评论不可靠、上下文面板占比计算、浏览器截图只有 1x 以及无法解除关联等问题，并发起关于会话统计与 SDK 暴露的讨论。
无提交，11 次 issue 互动，无发布。活动集中在 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 的图片输入与陈旧图像读取、子代理报 model_coming_soon、Windows 桌面版 CLI 入口请求，以及 worktree 删除修复的讨论。
11 次本人提交，无自动提交。移动端修复让表格卡片占满宽度并适配 375 与 414 视口；主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单，再改为紧凑图标分段；视觉精修加入渐变顶线、KPI 色条和斑马纹，并把 3 个插件并入资料库清单。
6 次本人提交，无自动提交，2 个版本。发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5，同时修正技能、规则、示例、README 和指南中的技能调用说明，包括移除斜杠命令引用和修复日语本地化。
4 次本人提交，无自动提交。改动只有 OpenChamber 截图样例：桌面 1440x900、1:1 面板区域、移动端 390x844，以及一张会话保留提示截图。
无提交，1 次 issue 互动，无发布。提交了一个 Shortcut Guide 问题：Hold-Win 激活抛出 NullReferenceException，且无法检查 runner 进程时没有任何显示。
1 次本人提交，无自动提交。唯一改动是新增移植 OpenChamber 功能的 DSH 插件。
